CustomField.description: <engagement link id>::<visitor key>. The external id the draft is upserted on, and the only way to reach it: the visitor key is a random value the browser generates and keeps, so a draft is readable only by the browser that wrote it. Not unique: a Guest User licence permits insert and read on a custom object and nothing else, so a save is an append and the newest row for a key is the draft. Indexed as an external id so that read stays cheap. Blank on every Draft_Type__c = 'Assessment' row -- required relaxed to false so this object can also hold the questionnaire draft, which addresses itself by Resume_Token__c instead. GtmFormDraftController's own saveDraft/getDraft/clearDraft return early when draftKey() yields null, so the guarantee that a Booking row always has this set moves from the schema into that controller.
CustomField.label: Draft Key
